purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of institutional data networks, catastrophe-risk benchmarks and interoperable observation services relevant to catastrophe risk.

entries.name: DRMKC Risk Data Hub API and geospatial services
entries.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / Disaster Risk Management Knowledge Centre
entries.spatial_scope: Europe, with dataset-specific coverage and administrative units
entries.temporal_scope: historical disaster-loss records plus current and derived risk datasets; dataset-dependent
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OGC API feature collections, GeoJSON/CSV responses and related geospatial service layers; dataset-dependent
entries.note: The API portal currently documents Risk Data Hub API 3.1.0 and CC BY 4.0 service-level reuse, but individual layers can aggregate external sources; freeze the exact collection, API version, source lineage, units and any third-party rights before use.

entries.name: GFDRR Risk Data Library
entries.provider: World Bank Group / Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery
entries.spatial_scope: global collection with project- and country-specific coverage
entries.temporal_scope: ongoing collection of disaster and climate risk assessments; individual dataset vintages vary
entries.resolution_or_granularity: heterogeneous raster, vector and tabular hazard, exposure, vulnerability and loss datasets
entries.note: The Risk Data Library is curated by GFDRR and includes public disaster-risk assessment datasets, but it is not one homogeneous asset; pin the exact World Bank dataset identifier, files, version, license and upstream input lineage before use.

entries.name: GEM Global Exposure Model
entries.temporal_scope: current 2026 model generation with region- and source-specific underlying vintages
entries.resolution_or_granularity: global mosaic of residential, commercial and industrial building stock; open release aggregated at administrative level 1 with higher-resolution variants under separate licenses
entries.note: GEM exposes an open CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 aggregate and separately licensed higher-resolution variants. The current product page references both v2026.1 presentation material and a v2026.0.0 cited dataset, so exact release identity and commercial-use rights must be resolved before admission.

entries.name: GEM Global Vulnerability Model
entries.spatial_scope: global country and regional model collection
entries.resolution_or_granularity: country- and region-specific vulnerability functions by building typology, including structural, non-structural, contents and fatality consequences
entries.note: The open database is offered under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and commercial use requires a separate license. Preserve intensity measure, building taxonomy, loss component, country/region, function version and cited data release before comparing or using curves.

entries.name: WMO Information System 2.0
entries.provider: World Meteorological Organization and participating WIS2 centres
entries.spatial_scope: global WMO member and participating-centre network
entries.temporal_scope: operational since 2025-01-01 with continuously published data and metadata; archives are provider-dependent
entries.resolution_or_granularity: federated dataset notifications and downloads through MQTT, HTTP(S), Global Brokers, Global Discovery Catalogues and Global Caches
entries.note: WIS2 is a federation rather than one dataset. Core data are downloadable without access restrictions from Global Caches while recommended data can require provider access controls; pin centre ID, topic, discovery record, data class, provider and retrieval time.

entries.name: WMO Hydrological Observing System
entries.provider: World Meteorological Organization and participating hydrological data providers
entries.spatial_scope: global federation with national, regional and basin-specific provider coverage
entries.temporal_scope: real-time and historical hydrological data depending on the original provider
entries.resolution_or_granularity: provider station time series and metadata exposed through interoperable WHOS views, portals and web-service endpoints
entries.note: WHOS brokers heterogeneous hydrological providers and does not erase original source semantics. Preserve provider, station identifier, variable, unit, service endpoint, observation status and provider-specific access or reuse conditions.

entries.name: EUMETNET OPERA Radar Database
entries.temporal_scope: current operational inventory with archived radar-database views; last observed update 2026-06-17
entries.resolution_or_granularity: radar-site inventory with attributes such as band, Doppler capability, polarization, operational status and country; downloadable as CSV, XLSX and JSON
entries.note: This database is radar-network metadata, not radar reflectivity or precipitation observations. Use it to discover and freeze network/site metadata; actual radar products require separate source, product-version and rights review.

entries.name: European Severe Weather Database
entries.provider: European Severe Storms Laboratory and partner networks
entries.temporal_scope: historical and continuously collected severe-weather reports
entries.resolution_or_granularity: event and point reports with event-type metadata, source information and ESWD quality-control levels
entries.note: ESSL states that commercial use of public ESWD data is not allowed and broader access is agreement-based. Preserve report type, QC level, source provenance and duplication semantics; ESSL recommends QC1 as a lower bound for statistical studies.

entries.name: EMSC SeismicPortal FDSN Event service
entries.spatial_scope: EMSC event catalogue with strong Euro-Mediterranean operational focus and contributed seismic solutions
entries.temporal_scope: historical and near-real-time catalogue with event updates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: FDSN Event API returning event parameters and optionally all origins and arrivals in QuakeML, JSON or text
entries.note: The service is CC BY 4.0 and supports contributor/origin detail. Operational event solutions can change, so freeze event IDs, query, retrieval time, catalogue and contributing origins rather than treating a live response as immutable.

entries.name: PERILS Industry Exposure Database 2025
entries.spatial_scope: 21 PERILS-covered countries across Europe, Asia-Pacific and Canada in the 2025 release
entries.resolution_or_granularity: market sums insured by CRESTA zone, line of business and coverage type
entries.note: PERILS documents market sums insured by CRESTA zone, line of business and coverage type and added severe convective storm exposure in 2025. Treat this as a high-value benchmark lead, not open data; exact access, redistribution and commercial terms require provider-specific review.
